# Sound sources

All files are licensed CC0 1.0 as stated on their source pages. They are used as separate layers and mixed in the browser. They are not custom recordings of the character or a verified cinematic dragon performance.

- `blade_01`, `blade_03`, `chain_02`, `creature_roar_02`, `spell_01`, `spell_02`, `spell_fire_03`, `stones_03`: rubberduck, [80 CC0 RPG SFX](https://opengameart.org/content/80-cc0-rpg-sfx), CC0 1.0. Original archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/80-CC0-RPG-SFX_0.zip
- `magical_2`: JaggedStone, [Magic Spell SFX](https://opengameart.org/content/magic-spell-sfx), CC0 1.0. Original: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/magical_2.ogg
- License text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
